lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to make a character say something with a speech-bubble block, at the right moment in a script.
The say block makes a speech bubble.
Type the words you want your character to say.
Put the say block where you want the talking to happen: at the start, in the middle or at the end.
A character can say “Hi!” at the start and “Bye!” at the end.
In ScratchJr you can also record your own voice with the green sound block.
Walk to the star, THEN say “Hello!”.
The cat walked, then said hello!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
